channel.title: MongoDB incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from MongoDB's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Impaired Cluster operations in AWS me-central-1 and AWS me-south-1 [monitoring]
item.description: We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.

item.title: MongoDB Atlas Log Integration service degraded [resolved]
item.description: Between approximately 14:29 UTC and 15:42 UTC on August 28, 2026, log delivery via Atlas Log Integration was impacted due to an internal service issue. Some users may have encountered delayed or missing logs during this window. Log delivery has since returned to normal. We are implementing measures to reduce the risk of this happening again.

item.title: Issues rotating certificates for projects containing only Atlas Free and Flex clusters [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Atlas UI and API Periodic Unavailability [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved.
Following the incident, we identified an issue that caused some internal Atlas jobs not to start as scheduled, resulting in delays to certain changes.
The issue was related to this incident "Atlas UI and API Periodic Unavailability" which has been remediated.
Customer clusters and their data were not affected; the impact was limited to the timing of control-plane operations. This jobs issue has been resolved as well.

item.title: GCP capacity constraints affecting Atlas deployments [resolved]
item.description: We believe the symptoms of this have largely subsided, looking at both customer cases and our internal metrics. We will share any more information as we get it, but for now resolving this incident as Atlas is fully operational.

item.title: MongoDB Atlas: Atlas UI loading issues [resolved]
item.description:
From 2026-06-25 06:55 UTC to 2026-06-25 07:10 UTC, some users may have experienced intermittent Atlas UI loading failures. We identified elevated traffic to a number of endpoints that increased latency in the Atlas UI service. This caused internal health checks to fail and temporarily reduced healthy Atlas UI capacity.
We restored healthy Atlas UI capacity and applied additional rate limiting to the affected traffic paths. We are continuing follow-up work to further reduce the risk of recurrence.
